payload.root_cause: Off-by-one in `Cart.subtotal()`: it iterates `for i in range(len(self.items) - 1)`, which excludes the final line item from the sum. For a 3-line cart (mugs 25.00, lamp 39.99, pens 3.00) it sums only the first two lines, yielding 25.00 + 39.99 = 64.99 instead of 67.99 — the pens line is silently dropped. It should iterate over all items (`for item in self.items: total += item.total`). Note this also makes `subtotal()` return 0.00 for a single-item cart, and it corrupts every downstream consumer (`order_total`'s subtotal/discounted/shipping/tax/total).
